text: Jo is alone on the overnight shift; the shop is locked till six and service is through the night pay drawer; the nearest help is a long way off.
Jo has a grown son, Kieran, who has been in and out of trouble for years; she does not hear from him, and he is the kind of man who could be the one bleeding at a window at three in the morning.
There is a panic button under the counter that calls it in; once she presses it there is no taking it back.
